summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated only on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one branch that calls term.set_title(title) for the title control; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_console.py::test_set_window_title (sequence assertion skipped on legacy Windows, return value always checked), test_control.py::test_control_title, and test_windows_renderer.py::test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only). Nothing has been run, so the tests are unverified. The Console method and renderer branch were placed after show_cursor and after the ERASE_IN_LINE branch respectively.
